newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens dips after flat H1 results.
newsitem.headline: Siemens dips after flat H1 results.

text.p: Shares in German electronics and engineering giant Siemens AG on Wednesday dipped 80 pfennigs to 90.10 marks, against the higher market trend, after reporting half-year profits flat at 1.08 billion marks.
Dealers said that while the results were broadly in line, even somewhat higher than expectations, they had failed to enthuse investors to value the stock more highly.
An accompanying forecast for "stable" year profits by the firm also gave little buying impetus to the market, they added.
Other traders noted that Siemens stock had already risen strongly in recent days and that the initial market reaction afetr the results could be simple profit-taking.
